units.source_text: 他想：“她所居的山乡在哪里呢？

en.t: He wondered, "Where is the mountain village where she lives?

units.source_text: 我总要想个巧妙的办法到那里去看一看。

en.t: Somehow I must think of a clever way to go there and see for myself.

units.source_text: 首先要见到那僧都，才可知道确实情况。

en.t: First I must meet that Sozu; only then can I learn the truth.
I must go and visit the Sozu."

units.source_text: 他朝朝夜夜只是考虑此事。

en.t: Morning and night, he thought of nothing but this matter.

units.source_text: 每月初八日，规定举办法事，并上比叡山供养药师佛，

en.t: On the eighth day of every month, it was customary to hold a Buddhist service and go up Mount Hiei to make offerings to Yakushi Buddha,

units.source_text: 有时参拜山上的根本中堂。

en.t: and at times he also paid worship at the Konpon Chudo on the mountain.

units.source_text: 此次他准备下山后即赴横川，再由横川返京。

en.t: This time, after descending the mountain, he planned to go straight to Yokawa and then return to the capital from there.

units.source_text: 并且随带浮舟的弟弟小君同行。

en.t: He also brought Ukifune's younger brother, Kogimi, along with him.

units.source_text: 至于浮舟家中其他的人，他现在并不立刻通知，

en.t: As for the other people in Ukifune's household, he did not notify them at once,
but decided to wait and see how things turned out before saying anything.

units.source_text: 他之所以随带小君，大约是想使这做梦一般的情景增添些哀趣吧。

en.t: He probably took Kogimi with him because he wished to add a little pathos to this dreamlike scene.

units.source_text: 他在一路上做种种猜想：

en.t: Along the way, he let his mind wander through all sorts of conjectures:

units.source_text: “如果认明了确是浮舟，而其人已经变装，

en.t: "If it turns out for certain to be Ukifune, but she has already changed her appearance,
and is mingling among a crowd of nuns,

units.source_text: 或者，闻到了她另有情夫等不快之事，

en.t: or if I hear some unpleasant news, such as that she has another lover,
how deeply that would grieve me!"
